assets.W4: Checkweigher with cap and label inspection

I01.question: Underweight rejects high on W4 (W4-A17), why?
I01.answer: The fault started at F1, upstream of W4: F1.fill_pressure on F1 went down at 12:12, 5 min before the alarm on W4. Likely cause: a clogged filling nozzle. Suggested action: Clean the filling nozzles and check the product valve. Sources: M-F1 (Filler: fill pressure), T009 (Abfueller duesen verstopft, Druck zu niedrig, ...), T035 (Abfueller duesen verstopft, Druck zu niedrig, ...).

I02.question: W4 meldet W4-A21, was ist die Ursache?
I02.answer: The fault started at C2, upstream of W4: C2.torque on C2 went down at 16:14, 5 min before the alarm on W4. Likely cause: capper torque drifting low (worn clutch). Suggested action: Check the capper clutch pads and the torque setpoint. Sources: M-C2 (Capper: torque), T010 (Verschliesser Drehmoment zu niedrig, Kupplung ...), T045 (Verschliesser Drehmoment zu niedrig, Kupplung ...).

I03.question: Label inspection rejects high on W4 (W4-A22), why?
I03.answer: The fault started at L3, upstream of W4: L3.glue_temp on L3 went down at 20:07, 8 min before the alarm on W4. Likely cause: labeler glue too cold (heater). Suggested action: Check the glue roller heater cartridge and thermostat. Sources: T011 (labeller glue roller cold, labels wrinkled), M-L3 (Labeler: glue and outfeed), T030 (labeller glue roller cold, labels wrinkled).

I04.question: P5 meldet P5-A03, was ist die Ursache?
I04.answer: The fault started at R6, downstream of P5: R6.gripper_vacuum on R6 went up at 00:18, 6 min before the alarm on P5. Likely cause: a vacuum leak at the palletizer gripper. Suggested action: Replace the suction cups and check the vacuum hoses. Sources: M-R6 (Palletizer: gripper vacuum), T019 (palletiser vacuum hose leaking, robot fault, ...), T005 (R6 suction cup torn).

I05.question: Outfeed blocked on L3 (L3-A02), why?
I05.answer: The fault started at CV34, downstream of L3: CV34.motor_current on CV34 went up at 04:03, 1 min before the alarm on L3. Likely cause: a jam on the conveyor before the checkweigher. Suggested action: Clear the jam on the conveyor before the checkweigher. Sources: T003 (Stau Transportband CV34), T029 (Stau Transportband CV34), T043 (Stau Transportband CV34).

I06.question: W4 meldet W4-A18, was ist die Ursache?
I06.answer: The fault is at W4 itself: W4.weight on W4 went up at 08:52, 1 min before the alarm on W4. Likely cause: load cell drift on the checkweigher. Suggested action: Recalibrate the load cell with the reference weight. Sources: M-W4-v2 (Checkweigher: weight rejects (revised)), T002 (Waage driftet, Referenzgewicht falsch, neu ...), T034 (Waage driftet, Referenzgewicht falsch, neu ...).
